abilities.desc_en: Lieutenants – Shockwave - The last hit of Megatron’s Medium Combo has a {{var_29}}~{{var_30}} chance to inflict a Power Rate Debuff, reducing the opponent’s Power Rate by {{var_31}} for {{var_32}}. This debuff may be Fused to the opponent.

abilities.desc_en: All Decepticons on your team gain +{{var_33}}~{{var_34}} Armor while fighting Decepticons and +{{var_35}}~{{var_36}} Power Rate while fighting Autobots.
